question.text: Operational Due Diligence (ODD) for Cat III AIFs focuses on:

answer.text: Service providers, compliance, tech infrastructure, internal controls

explanation.text: The Logic: ODD evaluates service provider quality, compliance/regulatory, technology, and internal controls — operational backbone of the fund. The Trap: Other focus areas are part of investment DD, not operational DD. Cross-Exam Context: Standard institutional DD framework. Distributor's Pro-Tip: ODD failure can kill a fund — separate ODD from IDD (investment DD) when scoping.
